description: Turn 1 response for the two-phase direct Codex PR review: either finalize the review immediately or request a single batch of read-only context lookups.

action.description: Use final when the pre-packed diff and context are sufficient to conclude. Use fetch_context only when you need additional read-only files, truncated diffs, or literal grep lookups before finalizing in Turn 2.

context_requests.description: When action is fetch_context, list up to 12 read-only lookup requests. When action is final, return an empty array.

type.description: Read-only lookup primitive executed by the trusted script without a shell.

path.description: Repository-relative path for read_file or git_diff, or optional directory/file scope for git_grep (empty string searches default source roots).

start_line.description: 1-based start line for read_file; set to 0 for git_diff and git_grep.

end_line.description: 1-based inclusive end line for read_file; set to 0 for git_diff and git_grep.

query.description: Fixed literal search text for git_grep; set to empty string for read_file and git_diff.

reason.description: Short reason explaining why this lookup is needed to verify a concrete risk.

coverage.description: When action is final, what the review actually covered. When action is fetch_context, return empty arrays.

inspected.description: Repository-relative paths whose complete diff or content you actually reviewed; do not add truncated or unread paths.

uncovered.description: Changed areas you could not judge, each written as path or path:line followed by the reason.

prior_resolutions.description: When action is final on an incremental review, one entry per prior finding indexed from 0; otherwise an empty array.

findings.description: When action is final, every review finding ordered by severity; when action is fetch_context, return an empty array.

severity.description: Severity level defined by the repository review rubric.

file.description: Repository-relative path the finding points at, or an empty string when it concerns the whole change.

line.description: Line number in the file as it exists in the reviewed head snapshot, or 0 when the finding is not tied to one line.

problem.description: The concrete defect or risk, stated as observable behaviour rather than preference.

suggestion.description: The smallest change that removes the problem.

summary.description: When action is final, one or two sentences stating what the change does and the overall conclusion; when action is fetch_context, return an empty string.
